Grain
Several components are required to product quality feeds. At Matthews Feed & Grain, we believe that it starts with corn. The majority of the corn we buy stays in our storage for the feed mill. Soybeans are shipped out through the year to processors in Indiana. Our grain customer base is loyal and long standing. Some of today’s customers are 4th and 5th generation farmers and customers at Matthews.
We are proud of the fact that the majority of bushels we buy are from a 15 mile radius of the mill. Due to our unique, county-line location, that 15 mile radius touches 4 Indiana counties. Grant, Delaware, Blackford and Madison counties are not only where the majority of our grain comes from, but those are also the counties that we first started selling feed to many years ago.
